issue.title: Bug: test_bgp_update_timer.py fails due to TSA maintenance mode

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

test_bgp_update_timer.py teardown calls config_reload, which restarts swss. If the platform is enabled with startup_tsa_tsb.service in services.conf, swss.sh restarts this service on every non-warm-boot, putting the DUT into TSA maintenance mode with a 15-minute TSB timer. That causes the tests that run before the timer fires to fail because PfxSnt: 1 (only loopback advertised).

### Steps to Reproduce

test_bgp_update_timer.py run in 202511 on NH-5010 or similar platforms where TSA is enabled via startup-tsa-tsb.conf and services.conf in the /usr/share/sonic/platform directory.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test passes when TSA maintenance mode doesn't kick in during the test's config reload.

### Relevant log output

resolution.title: [bgp] Clear TSA maintenance mode after config reload in test_bgp_update_timer
resolution.description:
## Description
On platforms with `startup_tsa_tsb` service enabled in `services.conf`, `config_reload` (from `setup_interfaces`) restarts swss which triggers TSA maintenance mode with a 15-minute TSB timer. Tests running before the timer fires fail because the DUT only advertises its loopback route (PfxSnt: 1).

### Fix
Check for TSA maintenance mode in `common_setup_teardown` before yielding to tests, and run `TSB` to clear it if active. Uses `TSC` to check current maintenance state.

### Changes
- `tests/bgp/test_bgp_update_timer.py`: Add TSA check/clear in `common_setup_teardown` fixture setup

Fixes: #23336
